name: Hợp đồng sắp hết hạn
prompt: Create ONE production-quality Vietnamese transactional email visual, not a website. 1024x1536 portrait; entire email visible, white outer margin, natural centered 600px layout, no browser chrome. AUTHORITATIVE REFERENCE: attached image is the exact user-approved AN KHANG HOME email crop. Preserve its real white logo plaque with navy/green AK + AN KHANG HOME wordmark, emerald illustrated apartment-building banner, large white headline at left, illustration at right, curved pale mint lower edge, left-aligned body, thin fact dividers, signature. Match the reference closely; do not invent a different brand. EXACT TEMPLATE: Hợp đồng sắp hết hạn; audience Tài khoản hệ thống; banner headline exactly 'HỢP ĐỒNG SẮP HẾT HẠN'. Semantic palette: violet; original logo colors remain navy/green. Banner illustration: cream apartment building, contract document and calendar page indicating upcoming date. Use a refined flat editorial illustration, not 3D. Date anchor 09/10/2026 Vietnam UTC+7; all supplied facts are synthetic and exact. BODY: Xin chào Chủ nhà, Hợp đồng Phòng 221 sắp hết hạn. Emphasize 'Thời gian còn lại' as 7 ngày. Facts: Phòng: Phòng 221; Người thuê: Nguyễn Minh Anh; Ngày hết hạn: 16/10/2026.  Closing: Vui lòng liên hệ người thuê để thống nhất gia hạn hoặc bàn giao phòng. No button and no external link; the message must be complete in the email. Close with 'Trân trọng,' and 'Đội ngũ An Khang Home'. Add tiny footer 'Dữ liệu minh họa · 09/10/2026'.  AVOID: Gmail/browser UI, tabs, device frame, other brands, SPX, QR, passwords, fake phone/contact details, clutter, cards inside cards, multiple CTAs, repeated headings, tiny unreadable text, clipped footer, misspelled Vietnamese, unsupported success stamp, invented amounts, people, photorealistic luxury real estate, code or HTML annotations.
